title: UI Tips by @gabriell_lab: Design Engineering Tip: Don’t apply backdrop-filter directly to your m
notes:
Design Engineering Tip: Don’t apply backdrop-filter directly to your modal. Move the blur to a separate pseudo-layer instead. Separating the blur from the content can reduce paint and compositing work, especially when animating the modal. Code snippet below.

Designer: @gabriell_lab. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
